description: Bare-substrate colour (8-bit sRGB as decoded from the camera PNG) of the acquisition mode on which model_0409_all.pth was previously run and visually reviewed: 3840x2160 frames of the 2026-09-24 inference examples. Derived from pixels that the same checkpoint predicted as bare substrate. It is a reference for the camera colour balance of that capture mode; it is not an independent reflectance calibration and not a label.
pixel_scale_note: Colour balance is independent of the 3840x2160 -> 1920x1080 pixel-count change; see docs/RESOLUTION_AND_INFERENCE.md.
substrate: SiO2/Si; historically labelled 276 nm, confirmed 260 nm on 2026-10-05
limits: Derived from model predictions on two frames of one microscope/camera lineage; not a physical reflectance standard.
A gain estimated from it is a diagnostic probe: the corrected prediction stays unvalidated until independent reference regions are reviewed.
Re-derive when the objective, illumination source, camera or oxide thickness changes; do not reuse across laboratories.
